svg.aria-label: Which trust store each client reads: curl and git with the OpenSSL backend read a PEM bundle file and --cacert or http.sslCAInfo replace it; Node and npm read a Mozilla CA list compiled into Node, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS appends and npm cafile replaces; pip 24.2 and later on Python 3.10+ reads certifi plus the OS store and --cert adds a bundle; Schannel clients read the Windows certificate store
